name: BSP_Plane_SweepCollisionPoints
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_projectile_helpers, read-only analysis. __thiscall int(Plane* p = ECX, void* a, void* b, void* extra, float step); body 007C0910-007C0C5F. The second caller of 0084BF00 and the reason that routine has a [shot+0CCh] IsKindOf(0Fh) branch: it passes p+72Ch as the shot, so [shot+0CCh] is the plane, class id 0Fh. Returns early while the cooldown [p+9DCh] is positive or [p+61h] is set, decrementing it by step. Iterates the collision-point vector [[p+538h]+5BCh]..[+5C0h] at stride 0Ch and transforms each point by the previous pose p+924h and the current pose p+0CCh into one segment of a 0C0h-byte local, which is the same eight-segment list 0084B380 and 0084B4B0 walk; the projectile path fills only one. Calls 0084BF00(list, p+72Ch, p, [p+730h], extra, &local) at 007C0C0A. Coverage partial: the per-point water-crossing arm 007C0A4x-007C0C30 is contract: unread. docs/PROJECTILE_HELPERS.md

name: BSP_Sphere_TransformAffine
evidence: [BSP reconstruction] Call007BB620 on matrix, register-input CRT sqrt00BF7030, store scale float, multiply signed source radius and store float before affine center004142E0. Copy XYZ and saved radius with FLD/FSTP. No abs or perspective divide. Finite result/CW parity established for masked nearest CW007F/027F, including harmless masked-inexact CRT path; NaN/domain/unmasked/other CW and full status-word parity remain open. Original ABI: ECX=source float4 sphere; stack[ESP+4]=destination float4, [ESP+8]=matrix; EAX=destination; RET8. Evidence: docs/MODEL_WORLD_BOUNDS.md; reports/model_world_bounds_audit.json. Descriptive names are hypotheses; typed C++ interfaces are not native ABI or game validation.

name: BSP_Plane_ReloadBombPlatforms
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = plane). Walks the plane device list from plane+48h (next at device+44h) and calls vtable[200h] on every device whose class test answers 25h, which covers MBombPlatform 25h and MMultipleBombPlatform 26h because the test walks the ancestor chain. The reload body behind vtable[200h] is unread. docs/AIR_OPERATIONS.md (packet cc2_air_operations).

name: BSP_PlaneEngineEffect_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(record, effect handle) that constructs the 44h-byte EngineEfxes record: it stores the handle at +0h with an InterlockedIncrement and seeds a run of float fields from DAT_00D7A24C = 1.0f and zero. Called by BSP_PlaneClass_ReadLuaFields 007D1F70 at 007D2FC2 for each EngineEfxes element before 007CCCA0 appends the record to the vector at plane descriptor +250h. The record's field meanings are not decoded. See docs/PLANE_CLASS_FIELDS.md.

name: BSP_PlaneEngineEffectVector_PushBack

name: BSP_PlaneClass_IsKindOf
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_unit_lists, read-only analysis. __thiscall bool(int classId), 007cfd00-007cfd1f read from the raw listing (no Ghidra function). Answers 15 (0Fh), 5 and 4: the plane base of the VehicleClass descriptor hierarchy.
